claim_scope: User-directed train-only restart from the preserved epoch-20 mid-epoch checkpoint, followed by bounded family-frequency feedback control from epoch 21. No validation or test_id claim during training.
hypothesis: Replaying the uncompleted second half of epoch 20 from the exact update-13650 optimizer checkpoint with unit controller weights, then enabling the preregistered bounded controller at epoch 21, will preserve deterministic sample coverage and produce finite adaptive continuation without skipping or double-updating a checkpointed step.
expected_mechanism: The fixed checkpoint stores model, optimizer, epoch, next-step, and update state. Resuming at step 350 completes only steps 350 through 699 under unit weights; the controller first updates at the next complete epoch boundary before epoch 21 training.
user_direction: Stop the epoch-21-boundary adaptive attempt and continue training from epoch 20.

controller.feedback_metric: mean normalized spectral energy error per family-frequency cell
controller.objective: 0.5 * mean cell relative error + 0.5 * worst cell relative error

failure_signal: Stop on resume-cursor drift, hash drift, non-finite loss or gradient, incorrect smoke next-step cursor, controller bounds violation, DDP rank failure, missing checkpoint, or any validation/test_id access.
promotion_rule: Training loss and controller-probe behavior cannot promote this checkpoint. Freeze the final adapter and parent first, then pass disjoint train confirmation before opening one complete validation evaluation.
rollback: Preserve the original fixed run, the epoch-21-boundary snapshot, the stopped adaptive attempt, and the immutable update-13650 checkpoint. On failure, do not delete artifacts; resume only from the immutable update-13650 checkpoint under a new versioned identity.
